sentences.span: the prices paid component moved up to a 4-year high of 72.6 (vs. 70.0 expected)
sentences.why: The 4-year-high services price detail is confirmed, but every Sept-4 file is a pre-release forecast/preview (NFP consensus ~55k, GS ~40k, JPM ~50k); no source contains an actual released print, so 'the official number says the opposite' has no textual support.

sentences.span: led futures to slash the chance of a hike to 51% as of this morning, down from 63% at the close on Wednesday
sentences.why: The 60-70% pre-Waller pricing and Thursday's break to 51% are correct, but the source states the probability is STILL 51% Friday morning, not reverted back up as the sentence's final clause claims.

sentences.span: showed a 58%m/m increase in job cuts, but the longer-run trend looks good
sentences.why: The 58% Challenger figure and JPM-desk attribution are correct, but JPM's own conclusion from that figure is reassurance ('layoffs remain low'), not 'softer than the headline' as the sentence asserts.

sentences.span: The three-month average is down 33%oya, the August total was the lowest August reading since 2022
sentences.why: Both figures and the 'does not carry the dovish case' framing match the JPM source verbatim.

sentences.span: JPMorgan's data-center note had OpenRouter token volume up roughly 47% month-over-month in August. Dollar spend was still only up about 7%
sentences.why: OpenRouter volume/spend figures are JPM's, but the token-index figures (29%, $0.97, half the May peak) are Silicon Data stats reported inside a Goldman Sachs note; tagging the whole sentence '(JPMorgan)' misattributes most of it.

sentences.span: Compute scarcity has been driving hyperscaler outperformance recently
sentences.why: Bank (TS Lombard), direction, and substance all match the source.

sentences.span: Broadcom expects its AI semiconductor revenue to double in FY27 to $115bn... raise our 12-month target price to $540 from $525
sentences.why: Buy rating, $540 PT, and $115bn FY27 guide are accurate, but the call is Goldman Sachs's, not 'the same house' (TS Lombard) established by the prior sentence.

sentences.span: Accounting for dark crossings, we estimate recent total Persian Gulf oil exports at roughly 15-16mb/d or 2/3 of pre-war levels, while recent visible exports stand at only 10mb/d
sentences.why: Goldman's dark-crossing accounting shows MORE oil flowing than visible data implies (supply is better, not worse); the sentence inverts the source's actual direction.

sentences.span: oil tankers crossing the Strait near the coast of Oman with their AIS off
sentences.why: All figures (15-16mb/d, 10mb/d visible, two-thirds of pre-war) and the Oman/AIS-off detail match the Goldman source exactly.

sentences.span: event vol in regional banks and small caps appears underpriced vs 2024 Presidential election moves, making hedges like IWM Nov puts worth considering
midterm elections have rarely elicited large broad market moves historically
options on regional banks (KRE) and small caps (RTY) appear most underpriced today relative to their 2024 election-week moves
sentences.why: Underpricing claim, 2024 comparison, IWM-over-index framing, and record-steep tail skew are all directly stated by BofA.

sentences.span: S&P vol is pricing in a relatively muted 0.82% move following this year's elections
sentences.why: 0.82% is the S&P/index-level priced move, not the IWM put's breakeven (~2.1%/96% strike); the note's thesis is that small caps could move independently of the index, so the sentence misapplies the figure to an outcome the source doesn't support.

sentences.span: IWM 3m ATM iVol which has collapsed to the 0.2% percentile... SPX Skew and Put Skew back to 2%ile... Dispersion profitability... cratered down to just the 5%-ile
sentences.why: All three percentile figures and the Nomura/McElligott attribution match the source exactly.

sentences.span: options market makers and dealers are choking on huge PNL losses, as anybody or anything long Optionality / long Skew has been bled-out
sentences.why: This market-maker-loss framing is tied in the source to the IWM iVol stat, not to the dispersion/5th-percentile stat ('that last one') it's attached to here.
